title: Envelope
description: An agent's write: one envelope is one version. Ops run in order against a running snapshot, so a later op can name what an earlier one added. A refused op is dropped with its reason and the rest apply. Semantics from Daybreak docs/BRIDGE.md (envelope version 2).

schemaVersion.description: This contract's version. Optional: Daybreak's file bridge doesn't send it.

id.description: The idempotency key. The same id with the same ops returns the original receipt; the same id with different ops is a conflict. Required by kit services (Daybreak's file bridge falls back to a SHA-256 of the file name and bytes).

source.description: Who sent it, as receipts and notes name it: pi, claude, codex, ghosted-server.

version.description: The envelope protocol generation (Daybreak bridge version 2). Not the schema version.

mode.description: apply: ops apply now, except ones whose policy waits for a person. propose: the whole envelope waits for a person to keep or reject it.

summary.description: Optional words from the sender, shown with the change.

op.title: Op
op.description: One operation. Its fields beyond `op` are defined by the service's ops registry, which also generates howToWrite, REST, MCP and CLI surfaces.
The registered op name: add_task, ticket.create.

id.description: Finds an existing thing by id. An id that's gone never falls back to a title.
